The '''Japrael sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].

In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[Envoy-class shuttle|''Envoy''-class shuttle]] ''[[Star-Wake]]'' was found drifting aimlessly in the Japrael sector, after [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] dumped it there from Onderon.
